title: Reading 2 · 同一场景，两种书评

config.body: 打开 Unit 4 Reading 2，找到 Piper 和 So 说明研究材料的段落。读标题时，先判断那句话听起来在谈作家、作品，还是书评作者。

teacher.note: 让同学先说直觉，再找段落中的研究单位。下一环节用自编场景观察书评如何选取细节。

config.body: Fictional scene · At the flood shelter, Mina tucked a blanket around her grandmother while a neighbor carried in dry boots. She marked safe routes on a street map and sent two volunteers to check the north road.
config.prompt: Choose what your review will foreground. Try both headlines, then submit the one you would print.

artifact.title: A granddaughter keeps watch
artifact.body: “Tucked a blanket around her grandmother” brings Mina’s care for her family into focus.

artifact.title: A young organizer maps a way out
artifact.body: “Marked safe routes” and “sent two volunteers” bring Mina’s work for the neighborhood into focus.

teacher.note: 给约 40 秒试排。请选不同头版的两位同学各念一个短语，再问哪一处情节两条标题都没提到。
teacher.explanation: Both reviews can quote the same story. They give different actions the lead. The neighbor carrying dry boots appears in neither headline.

steps.title: 头版如何改变读者预期？
steps.fallback: 自编场景：洪灾后，Mina 给祖母盖上毯子，一位邻居送来干靴子。Mina 在地图上标出安全路线，并派两名志愿者去查看北路。同桌分别用照料家人和组织志愿者开头，指出各自引用的动作，再找一个两人都略过的细节。

config.body: 把班级选出的头版和原场景放在一起。各找一个支持头版的动作，再找一个另一种头版更容易让读者注意到的动作。
config.prompt: Our review foregrounds … by citing … . A different lead would make readers notice … .

teacher.note: 班级的选择属于这次课堂演示。回到 Reading 2 时，请学生说出原研究实际比较的材料，并解释为什么选择强调一个细节会改变读者对同一本书的印象。

steps.title: 退场条 · 证据能支持哪一句？

config.body: Piper and So analyzed wording in a sample of published book reviews. They compared descriptions in reviews of books by women and men.
config.prompt: Choose a claim supported by those materials. Tell your partner what you would read to study the books’ themes directly.

options.label: The study identified the most common themes in the books themselves.
The study compared how reviewers described books by women and men in this sample.
The study counted all books published by women and men during the period.

teacher.note: 请学生先用英语复述研究材料，再说出一项可以用来研究作品主题的新材料。
teacher.explanation: The research materials were published reviews. A study of the books’ themes would need a sample of the books themselves, including attention to books that received no review.
